acceptance_criteria.description: Plaintext passwords and session tokens are absent from persistence, logs and response bodies wherever forbidden.
evidence: tests/integration/api/auth/registration-acceptance.test.ts proves Argon2id persistence and response exclusion.
tests/integration/identity/session-repository.test.ts proves only the SHA-256 token hash is stored.
tests/integration/api/auth/auth-journey.test.ts proves the session token appears only in the required cookie, not response bodies.

acceptance_criteria.description: Bootstrap credentials and secret are absent from database audit metadata, logs, responses and client assets.
evidence: tests/unit/auth/bootstrap-route.test.ts proves safe bodies and log calls.
tests/integration/identity/admin-bootstrap.test.ts proves Argon2id storage and metadata limited to role/status.
The synthetic canary webpack build reported none of 9 canaries in .next/static.

acceptance_criteria.description: Normalized emails and raw client IPs never enter rate-limit persistence or security logs, and rotating RATE_LIMIT_KEY_SECRET changes their HMAC keys.
evidence: tests/unit/rate-limit/rate-limit-keys.test.ts independently verifies D-44 HMACs and secret rotation.
tests/integration/rate-limit/rate-limiter.test.ts verifies distinct rotated keys and no raw email/IP in PostgreSQL.
tests/support/contracts/security-log.contract.ts proves extra email/IP fields are discarded.
